services.name: Stand Up Paddle Board (SUP) Rental
services.desc: Stand Up Paddle Board (SUP) Rental offers a fun, relaxing way to play on the water. You can paddle ocean surf or the calm water in the harbor. Stand Up Paddle Boarding delivers a full-body workout and thus has become a popular cross-training activity. And since you stand at your full height, you can enjoy unique views of everything from sea creatures to what’s on the horizon. Pillar Point Harbor is considered one of the safest harbors in the U.S. and is perfect for beginners and experts alike. services.name: Surf Zone and Wave Dynamics
services.desc: Surf Zone and Wave Dynamics Prerequisite: Solid basic paddling and rescue skills Surf Zone and Wave Dynamics Class This level two class is designed to improve on the skills you have learned from the Introduction to Sea Kayaking class. We’ll introduce you to the surf zone at Surfers’ Beach in Half Moon Bay and teach you the fundamentals of how waves form and break. We’ll focus on good judgment as well as launching and landing techniques. We’ll review basic strokes and introduce you to more advanced ones to tune your technique and set you up to safely practice on your own or with your friends. services.name: Sunset Paddle
services.desc: The Sunset paddle begins with a brief on land orientation, we'll take a relaxing paddle across Pillar Point Harbor in the late afternoon light. Along the way your guides will point out the local sights and wildlife, as the sea birds return to roost for the night. We'll float lazily on the calm waters as the sun sinks into the Pacific, before returning to the beach in the fading evening light. We provide wetsuits and waterproof paddle jackets for all classes, rentals, and tours. You bring sun block, sunglasses with retention strap, synthetic sweater, shoes that can get wet, and a hat. services.name: Kayak Storage
services.desc: Covered kayak storage available for your sea kayak at Pillar Point Harbor. Bring your own combination lock and enjoy the benefits of having your kayak right on the beach whenever you need it. We will have the boat waiting when you arrive and clean it when you leave. Our friendly service and attention to detail will ensure minimal effort on your part. services.name: Bike Rental
services.desc: Half Moon Bay State Park's Coastside Trail runs parallel to the Pacific Coast along what used to be the Ocean Shore Railroad. The railroad itself was in operation for just 14 years before it was driven out of business in the early 1920s by the automobile. However, the railroad had a tremendous effect on the Northern California coastline. It opened the area to agriculture, created new communities along the shoreline and made the coastal beaches prime tourist destinations. The Coastside Trail is truly a destination trail.
